testimonials.name: Mei Lin Chong
text: Aisyah built the site I'd been putting off for years. My whole experience with agencies had been three people in every meeting and nobody who could answer a technical question. Here the person I briefed was the person who built it, and it showed in every decision.
They were so on top of things that the first working version was in my inbox the week after we spoke.

Most importantly, they are honest people. Halfway through I asked for a booking feature that would have blown the budget; Aisyah talked me out of it and showed me a simpler route that does the job. It was the right call.
Thank you for a site I'm genuinely proud to send people to!

testimonials.name: Amir Hakimi
text: Aisyah is in a league of her own as a builder. She understood our business in one conversation, designed something that looks nothing like a template, and had it live before the agency we'd spoken to had sent a quote. If you're a small team that needs a proper website, she's the person to talk to.

testimonials.name: Arjun Menon
text: 10/10 experience with Daniel. I've never had a developer work with me the way he did — he scoped the order dashboard to exactly what our team needed, kept me updated at every stage, and launched it without a single day of downtime for us. I'd tell anyone to work with him.

testimonials.name: Farid Zulkifli
text: I had a great experience working with Daniel. He turned a spreadsheet we'd outgrown into a proper internal tool, including a few workflows I hadn't even thought to ask for. We've been running on it every day since launch. He stayed on top of the process from start to finish — scoping, staging, training the team, even chasing our domain provider. Highly recommended.

testimonials.name: Jason Teoh
text: Working with Priya was a genuine pleasure. She takes the time to understand what your business actually needs, and her attention to detail is unmatched — she kept refining until the copy and the design sounded like us. Thoughtful, relentless, and exceptional at her craft.

testimonials.name: Vikram Nair
text: Priya's great. She narrowed a very vague brief down to a site that actually converts, brought ideas we wouldn't have known to ask for, and explained every decision along the way. Responsive too — but never the 7am calls a lot of agencies seem to think are normal. Highly recommend working with her.

testimonials.name: Wei Jun Lau
text: Adam's mission is putting the right tool in front of the people who need it, and he happens to be the most capable engineer I've worked with. What made him great to work with wasn't just the quality of the build or how fast it went live. It was his patience and steady support through every question after launch — a rare thing when it comes to developers.

testimonials.name: Kelvin Ooi
text: Adam was foundational in getting our customer portal off the ground. Once we connected he took our stack, our timeline and what we actually wanted into account and proposed a build that we could ship in weeks. Along the way I really appreciated the check-ins, the pushback where it was needed, and the collaboration that led to a product I would never have got out of our own scattershot approach.

testimonials.name: Hafiz Rosli
text: Adam is incredibly helpful, going to great lengths to make sure you understand every part of what he's building for you. With his help and support, our WhatsApp order agent is now handling enquiries around the clock at Corvid AI!

bio: Nur Aisyah Rahman is the founder and Chief Executive Officer of FF Dev Studio. She started the studio after a decade of building websites and internal tools for other people’s agencies, and still leads the projects that matter most herself — from the first brief to the launch checklist.

Before FF she ran product for a payments startup in Kuala Lumpur, where she learned that the fastest way to lose a client is to put three people between them and the person writing the code. That conviction shapes how the studio works: fewer projects, direct conversations, and work that is finished properly.

Daniel came to the studio from engineering management at a logistics company, which is why the order flows, dashboards and integrations tend to land on his desk.
